name: STA130H1 — Correction Attribution (Confidence Intervals)

steps.template_en: '95% CI means 95% probability parameter is in [a,b].' WRONG! Parameter is FIXED. 95% CI: if repeated sampling, ~95% of intervals would contain the true parameter.
steps.template_zh: '95%CI意味着参数95%概率在区间内。'错！参数固定。95%CI：重复抽样时约95%区间含真实参数。

steps.template_en: For x̄ from N(μ,σ²) with known σ: 95% CI = x̄±1.96σ/√n. Unknown σ: use t: x̄±t_{n-1}·s/√n. Why t? Estimating σ adds uncertainty → wider intervals.
steps.template_zh: σ已知：x̄±1.96σ/√n。σ未知：用t: x̄±t_{n-1}·s/√n。为什么t？估计σ增加了不确定性→更宽区间。

steps.template_en: CI = set of parameter values NOT rejected by two-sided test at α. Inversion: 95% CI contains all μ₀ where t-test fails to reject H₀: μ=μ₀. Duality is FUNDAMENTAL.
steps.template_zh: CI=在α水平双侧检验中不被拒绝的参数值集合。95%CI包含所有t检验不拒绝的μ₀。对偶性是基本的。

steps.template_en: 95% CI communicates BOTH estimate (center) AND precision (width). Wide CI → imprecise. Narrow CI → precise. CI is MORE INFORMATIVE than p-value — shows RANGE of plausible effect sizes.
steps.template_zh: 95%CI同时传达估计(中心)和精度(宽度)。宽CI→不精确。窄CI→精确。CI比p值更提供信息——展示可能的效应量范围。

steps.template_en: Study: mean diff=2.3, 95% CI=[0.8,3.8], p=0.003. (1) Interpret CI correctly. (2) Would 99% CI be wider/narrower? (3) Would 90% CI include 0? (4) If n doubled, interval wider/narrower? (5) What does CI tell that p doesn't?
steps.template_zh: 研究：均值差=2.3, 95% CI=[0.8,3.8], p=0.003。(1)正确解释CI。(2)99%CI更宽/窄？(3)90%CI包含0吗？(4)n翻倍区间更宽/窄？(5)CI告诉了什么p没告诉的？

steps.template_en: CI ≠ Bayesian credible interval (though numerically similar). 95% credible: '95% probability parameter is in this range (given data + prior).' What most people THINK a CI means — needs Bayes.
steps.template_zh: CI≠贝叶斯可信区间(数值常相似)。95%可信：'参数有95%概率在此范围(给定数据和先验)。'大多数人认为CI的意思——需贝叶斯。
